verdict.rationale: Conductor isolates agent work in separate git worktrees and branches per workspace, and offers cloud sandboxes where agents can test repositories, run builds, and edit setup scripts. Checkpoints let you revert code and chat state. This isolation is at the code and filesystem level; nothing documents separation from production data or services. Missing for 10: documented isolation of production data/databases or credentials, seeded or mock test-data environments, and independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox testing.
